strings: r_c made sure m_c was personally introduced to everyone in the Clan.
r_c advocated strongly for m_c to join the Clan.
r_c told m_c to let {PRONOUN/m_c/object} know if they ever needed any help adjusting to Clan life.
r_c made sure m_c knew to come to {PRONOUN/r_c/object} if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} were injured or ill.
